entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.

Preference. The color isn't what I expected. The box is unopened, so it's brand new.
I understand. One moment while I pull up the policy... Okay, I see the delivery was 38 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.

You're most welcome. Is there anything else for you today?
Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a great day.
